about_the_game: As a special thank you to Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 fans, we present Nos vies en Lumière (Bonus Edition), a 22-track album including the fully remixed and remastered 33-minute version of ‘Nos vies en Lumière’ alongside several pre-release and alternate version bonus tracks (total run time of 1 hour 33 min).
